config._purpose: PREREGISTRATION T83, stage 1: is curl on a warm two-dimensional sheet felt at a distance? Flat tori of 16 x 16 and 32 x 32 points at lambda = 1.02 and 1.25, warmed at fixed couplings from cold to past the melting edge, the per-edge correlation by graph distance read from snapshots as T16 did. The owner's prediction, SHORT, was given before this config was written. The held-out size 64 x 64 is a separate config written after this one is read (rule 14). Couplings set after a scratch smoke test (8 x 8, 150 sweeps, g = 1 and 3) accepted no move at all: the flat sheet's cheapest move costs 32, so the warm range is g = 2 to 8, bracketing the crossover near g = 5.
config.name: t83_curl_corr_stage1
